1531601.name: Crystal Missile
1531601.description:
Fires crystals from its back.
The crystals can be intercepted.

1531603.name: Big Crystal Missile
1531603.description: Launches a huge crystal missile that can be intercepted with a certain number of hits.

1531604.name: Crystal Light
1531604.description: The sinister crystal exudes menace, inflicting a debuff on all Nikkes.

1531605.name: Crystal Piercer
1531605.description:
Fires a barrage of crystals, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Crystal Chamber generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Crystal Piercer. While the barrier is up, only Fire Code Nikkes can deal damage.

1531606.name: Reflection Laser
1531606.description: Fires a laser beam, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1531607.name: Crystal Scattershot
1531607.description: Detonates the crystal energy stored in the pillar, sending crystal shards flying and dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1531611.name: Small Crystal Missile
